rationale: Phase 3F.1.5.1's mission was to determine whether Phase 3F.1.5's failed second-pass agreement gate reflects a real methodology defect or two specific, previously-hypothesized confounders (a communication gap and the absence of a live semantic judge) - and to test that, not assume it. This phase completed all of the credential-independent forensic and design work the charter requires happen BEFORE any rerun (items 2-5, 8 fully satisfied; items 6-7 designed and ready), and in doing so materially advanced understanding of the original failure: 65.6% of the detailed disagreements are shown to be a taxonomy-vocabulary artifact rather than genuine disagreement, the largest genuine disagreement cluster is shown to be validated (not merely asserted) as correct via a concrete false-credit-reproduction case, and one previously-undetected, real V2 defect was found and documented (not fixed). However, the charter's Section 7 makes live semantic judgment a hard, explicit prerequisite for the ordered rerun (Section 12), and this phase, following the SAME re-verification discipline Phase 3F.1.5 itself established, directly confirmed no authorized model credential (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) exists in this execution environment. Per the charter's own unambiguous instruction, this phase STOPS here rather than substituting a mock, a scripted responder, or a same-environment Claude Code subagent dispatch for the specifically-required live model credential, and rather than declaring a PASS on the strength of the forensic/design work alone when the numeric gate (items 9-10) was never re-measured.
